name: Eco Woodworks
old_description: Eco Woodworks is an Olympia based woodworking shop that specializes in custom carpentry & historical restoration. For over two decades, our goal has been to work with customers to transform their homes into more beautiful & usable spaces. We exercise sustainability & focus on preservation wherever possible throughout our entire process. We believe in a culture of community & educational outreach through local partnerships.
about:
Eco Woodworks operates from Tumwater, Washington, serving the greater Olympia area. The shop was established more than two decades ago as a custom carpentry and historical restoration business, though the exact founding year and founders’ names are not publicly documented. The company has remained independently owned, focusing on woodworking for residential and historic properties.

The shop provides a range of woodworking services, including custom carpentry, historical restoration, wood window restoration and repair, new wood window manufacturing, custom cabinet and furniture making, door fabrication, finish carpentry remodeling, and handcrafted mantels and millwork. All pieces are built in the company’s own shop, with projects spanning fully custom to semi‑custom designs. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Eco Woodworks serves homeowners, historic property stewards, and contractors seeking period‑appropriate woodwork. The company has worked on historic sites around Olympia following the Secretary of the Interior’s Federal Guidelines for preservation, and it regularly restores windows, doors, and millwork for historic homes. Its cabinet and furniture projects address both functional and aesthetic needs in residential remodels.

The firm emphasizes sustainability and preservation throughout its process, aiming to reduce energy consumption through weatherized window solutions without compromising original views. It also cites a culture of community and educational outreach through local partnerships as a core differentiator, and it balances budget and desire by offering both fully custom and semi‑custom build options.
